# pvecli pool info

Show detailed information about a pool.

```text
pvecli pool info [POOLID] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `POOLID` | Pool ID. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |
